name: Invert — "switch the power and toughness of each of up to two target creatures" switches only the targets
notes: Found by the audit (2026-11-19), once it read "switch target creature's power and toughness" and "switch the power and toughness of … target …" as layer-7d units. "each of" in front of "up to two target creatures" hid the target, so the switch was global: every creature on the board was switched as soon as Invert was cast. The switch parser now drops "each of" before a target (Inversion Behemoth's "each of any number of target creatures" already read). Goblin Piker, not picked, stays 2/1.
